ModMetaData.name: Xenogerm Trader Stock
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds complete xenogerms for preset xenotypes to the stock of exotic goods traders, so you can buy a xenotype instead of collecting every gene yourself.
An implanted xenogerm gives the person that xenotype, not a custom copy of it. Prices, stock sizes and the xenotypes for sale can be changed in the mod settings. Xenotypes added by other mods are included automatically.
